title: Combining head bounds across runs
statement: Let $M$ be a Boolean Turing machine with $k$ work tapes, let $c$ be a configuration on input $x$, and let $a,b,B$ be natural numbers. Suppose every configuration reached from $c$ by time $a$ has all work-tape heads in $[-B,B]$, and every configuration reached in at most $b$ steps from the configuration at time $a$ has the same bound. Then every configuration reached from $c$ by time $a+b$ has all work-tape heads in $[-B,B]$.
